children: Democratic Rep. Jared Moskowitz fended off a challenge from Republican Scott Singer, the Associated Press said, after a mid-decade redistricting in Florida prompted him to shift into a more competitive district.
With 95% of the vote reported, Moskowitz had 51.5% to 46.4% for Singer.

Moskowitz has served in Florida's 23rd District since 2023. When GOP lawmakers redrew the map this spring, Moskowitz opted to run in the neighboring 25th District. Moskowitz, a staunch defender of Israel, prioritized lowering healthcare costs and protecting Social Security and Medicare.
Singer, the former mayor of Boca Raton who was endorsed by President Trump, ran on a platform of supporting Israel and securing the southern border.
